test: RFC check digit accepts the SAT's own test RFCs
RFC with a wrong check digit, date or length is refused
receiver regime and CFDI use must apply to the kind of person
público en general only with 616/S01, and regimes come from the SAT catalog
a valid CSD with a PBES2/3DES key opens and reports RFC, SAT serial and expiry
a wrong password is refused (La contraseña no abre el archivo .key, o el archivo no es una llave privada del SAT)
a .key from other sellos is refused (El archivo .key no corresponde al .cer: son de sellos distintos)
an e.firma (FIEL) is told apart from a CSD (Ese certificado es tu e.firma (FIEL). Para facturar se usa el Certificado de Sello Digital (CSD), que se tramita con la e.firma en CertiSAT)
an expired CSD is refused before it reaches the PAC (El CSD venció el 2026-11-06; tramita uno nuevo en CertiSAT)
a CSD of another RFC than the license's is refused (El CSD es del RFC XIA190128J61 y esta sucursal está registrada con el RFC EKU9003173C9)
in production the certificate must come from the SAT (El certificado no lo emitió el SAT)
the sandbox accepts the SAT test authority's certificates
a file that is not a certificate is refused (El archivo .cer no es un certificado válido)
the branch opens what was sealed to its intake key
an envelope does not open for another license
an envelope does not open as another sending
a modified envelope is refused by AES-GCM
another machine's intake key cannot open it
the branch opens an envelope sealed with WebCrypto by Culinary Dueño
the CSD goes to PUT TaxEntity/UploadCsd and 204 means loaded
the body carries exactly the certificate, the key in base64 and the password
a refusal is reported with Facturama's reason and without the password
a PAC that is down leaves the sending for the next look
